title: Two Hamzahs in One Word - ءَامَنتُمْ in Surah Ṭāhaʾ
titleEn: Two Hamzahs in One Word - ءَامَنتُمْ in Surah Ṭāhaʾ
description: The word ءَامَنتُمْ in Surah al-Ṭāhaʾ is paired with an additional أَ for Imams Nafi', Bazzi, Abu 'Amr, Ibn 'Amir, Hamzah, Kisai and Shu'bah. Thus while for the Imam Hafs and Qunbul the rules of two hamazat don't apply here as for them there is only 1 hamzah in this word in Ṭāhaʾ:71, for the remaining qurra they do. Notice how this differs for Imam Qunbul who in the same word in al-Aʿrāf did pair and additional أ.

tashil_of_second.title: Tashῑl of 2nd
tashil_of_second.description: Tashῑl as described before refers to reciting a hamzah with a blend of the long vowel corresponding to the ḥarakah (short vowel) on it. These qurra will pair an extra hamzah to the start of this word which will be read with tahqiq and the 2nd hamzah with tashῑl.

tahqiq_of_both.title: Taḥqīq of both
tahqiq_of_both.description: Both hamzahs will be read clearly (taḥqīq) with no changes made to either - ءَأَٰمَنتُمْ
